_doc: The driver's rig, per location (see README.md). exposure_ev, world_gain and light_gain scale only what the scene's own lights and world already say; fills are extra lights (named in the notes); overview is the wide still's own camera; overview_scene names the scene whose lighting the overview uses.

the-pens.reference_card: The reference painting for the pens shows a small seated shape at the right of the floor that reads as a figure at sheet size; man-eater keeps no figure imagery, so the reference is left out of this sheet.
